audit.whatIsWrong: All 7 phases[].side read 'Skill' (even/mirror language) while content win[0..6] are all 'Rakan' and packet.levelChart is Rakan across every row — the chart contradicts the level-by-level prose beneath it.
audit.why: Rakan's mobility (free-recast E, W dash-knockup, R charm-dash) lets him dodge Galio's short walk-up engage and dictate every commit from level 1 through 2+ items — nothing in the kit gives Galio a stage he actually wins here.
audit.corrected: Moved all 7 phases[N].side to Rakan, rewrote each why to state the real reason, and lowered ratings to reflect Rakan favor throughout. win[N] already read Rakan for every row, so no content edit was needed for the chart values.

audit.why: Grand Entrance is 14/13/12/11/10s, and its free E recast extends the engage window — worth stating as a number.
audit.corrected: Added the real cooldown to breakdown.cooldowns.

audit.whatIsWrong: needs-antiheal is absent: Gleaming Quill heals Rakan's allies on champion hit, and nothing on the page states Grievous Wounds timing for extended trades.
audit.why: missingInteractions flags this for the matchup, and packet defect notes spikes[] only has 3 entries where 4 are expected.
audit.corrected: Added spikes[3] (was missing) covering the anti-heal timing. Also fixed the two copy-paste-bled dos/don'ts to carry real content instead of the pasted tradeGood/tradeBad strings.

edits.before: Q the pair — the tornado tick chips duos that stand in formation.
edits.after: His mobility lets him dodge your slow walk-up from the very first trade.

edits.before: W charge threat begins: the taunt governs their engage plans already.
edits.after: Grand Entrance knockup gives him a stronger all-in at 2 than you have.

edits.before: Full kit: E-W the committed trade and the magic shield refunds their poke.
edits.after: He simply dashes over your short E engage whenever he commits full.

edits.before: Zone with taunt threat and shield the margins — AP duos pay double rent.
edits.after: Through 4-5 his double-dash tempo still outruns your single engage.

edits.before: Hero's Entrance online — every roam your duo survives, you end.
edits.after: The Quickness charm-dash makes him near-impossible to pin down.

edits.before: First item: the taunt rotation chunks and the MR makes mage supports cry.
edits.after: First item: he still times the engage and leaves before taunt lands.

edits.before: Late Galio is the anti-dive: taunt their engage off your carry and R the map's emergencies.
edits.after: Late fights: he dives, W-shields, and dashes out while you've spent your one committed jump.

edits.before: - Rakan Grand Entrance: matchup-defining — The leap knockup starts every play — track him in fog; the E extends it. It writes your spacing rules. - W Shield of Durand is for saving fights, not seasoning trades. - The R opens or closes fights — pick one per cast.
edits.after: - Rakan Grand Entrance (14s at rank 1, 10s maxed): matchup-defining — the leap knockup starts every play, and his free E recast extends it. - W Shield of Durand is for saving fights, not seasoning trades. - The R opens or closes fights — pick one per cast.

edits.before: Bait the answer, start the chain, and let your carry collect — engage trades are all-or-nothing; pick the all.
edits.after: W-shield the ally he knocks up with Grand Entrance — it blunts the follow-up before The Quickness closes it out.

edits.before: Engaging into a banked disengage — the chain that starts answered is a donation with armor.
edits.after: His E shield recasts for free — trading into a fresh shield just feeds his sustain for nothing.
Gleaming Quill heals his allies on champion hit, so extended trades favor him unless you time Grievous Wounds — buy anti-heal early and apply it before you commit to a long fight.
